Questions and answers

What is Penalización de Peso?

In this glossary, Penalización de Peso refers to: An increase in operational weight or a reduction in allowable weight imposed due to specific inoperative equipment or configuration deviations.

How is Penalización de Peso used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Debido a una penalización de peso, la masa de despegue debe reducirse en 300 kilogramos."

Definition

An increase in operational weight or a reduction in allowable weight imposed due to specific inoperative equipment or configuration deviations.

Operational example

Due to a Weight Penalty, the takeoff mass must be reduced by 300 kilograms.

Localized term

Penalización de Peso

Localized example

Debido a una penalización de peso, la masa de despegue debe reducirse en 300 kilogramos.
